summary: Verified new patient portal Sex + Address feature end-to-end on /portal/account and nav-profile tab. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass — POST /api/portal/profile/sex rejects 'Other' and empty (400), accepts Male/Female/X, persisted in overview; POST /api/portal/profile/address instant-updates and persists; both require auth. Frontend (Playwright as john.smith with sex cleared): amber acct-sex-prompt shows, Set now opens Select with exactly [Male, Female, X], saving hides amber and shows value in acct-sex, persists after reload; Address edit fills all fields, saves instantly, composed 'street #unit · city, prov · postal' displays and persists after reload; nav-profile tab present and routes to /portal/account; regression acct-edit-phone and acct-hc-update still visible.
critical_code_review_comments: AddressUpdateBody accepts arbitrary strings with no length caps or postal-code format validation (e.g. Canadian A1A 1A1). Consider server-side sanitisation/max-length to avoid oversized payloads.

portal_update_address unconditionally overwrites all five fields to None when omitted (payload {}) because dict comprehension always includes the key. Semantically 'partial update' on address becomes a full replace; may be intentional (form always submits all fields) but worth documenting or switching to $set only for provided keys.

SexUpdateBody / AddressUpdateBody use `sex: str` and no `strip=True` at Pydantic level; endpoints trim manually — acceptable but pydantic v2 constraints (StringConstraints) would be cleaner and give consistent 422 validation.
get_patient_record is called on every profile write; ensure it is O(1) indexed on user id. No index issue observed but worth confirming for scale.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: nav, amber prompt, sex save+persist, address save+persist, regression phone/HC)

test_credentials: john.smith@demo.com / Patient2026! (sex unset via mongo before UI test); carlos.perez@demo.com / Patient2026! used for backend all-options test.

If main agent needs to demo the amber prompt again, unset sex on a demo patient via `db.patients.updateOne({email:'X'},{\$unset:{sex:''}})`. nav-profile testid confirmed on bottom nav.
